purpose: Quantify Herstatt risk elimination and FX spread savings from Arc StableFX 24/7 atomic PvP settlement vs non-CLS bilateral FX. Methodology: BIS (Allsopp et al. 1996) Herstatt credit cost proxy via counterparty spread. PFMI P12 atomic settlement; BIS FX Global Code P35 netting.
